title: Adjacency-walk machine
statement: For a Boolean parameter $\ell$, define a four-register machine with five available deciders and the labels in the walk control graph as follows. At each label it performs the specified register operation, branch, decider call, or return: it validates the first input payload; scans input and gate indices; tests gate kinds and arguments; scans circuit edges and output vertices; and, at an emitted site, compares the input payload with register zero, returning the disjunction of $\ell$ and the site's bit on a match, or incrementing register zero and proceeding to the site's successor label otherwise.
